newsitem.title: USA: Enron to manage energy for 11 cities - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Enron to manage energy for 11 cities - WSJ.

text.p: In an agreement that could serve as a model for other public-private partnerships in a deregulated electricity market, Enron Corp on Wednesday is expected to announce it will manage the energy affairs of 11 Northern California cities, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
The story said Enron is to team up with the Northern California Power Agency to manage the agency's power supply and energy sales.
The agency generates, transmits and distributes electricity to 11 cities and three utility districts, the story said.

About 25 percent of the country's electricity comes from smaller municipal agencies like the Northern California Power Agency, that face the specter of increased competition from larger utilities as deregulation opens transmission lines to third-party sales, the story said.
